audit.summary: Critical structural failure: the 320×480 ad unit cannot be rendered. The DOM lacks the required format container with id="ad-320x480". This is a blocker preventing screenshot capture and ad delivery.

findings.issue: No DOM node found for format "320x480". The screenshot capture system tried multiple selectors (#ad-320x480, data attributes, inline styles) but found no matching element. The ad container is missing or incorrectly named.
findings.fix_hint:
In index.html, ensure the main ad wrapper has id="ad-320x480" (matching the format ID exactly). The element must be a direct or immediate child of the body, with explicit width and height attributes or inline styles set to 320px and 480px. Example structure:
...

audit.regeneration_prompt: Regenerate index.html with the following mandatory structure: (1) Create a root container with id="ad-320x480" and inline styles width: 320px; height: 480px; positioned at the document root. (2) Center this container on the page using body { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }. (3) Inside #ad-320x480, structure the ad layout with LEGO brand logo (top, scaled appropriately), headline in Cera Pro 800 weight (Légende du foot or equivalent French copy), product image (Messi/Ronaldo/Mbappé/Vini Jr LEGO minifigure or set packshot, centered, responsive), and a CTA button (Arial 700 bold underline, in primary LEGO red #E3000B or LEGO yellow #FFED00). (4) Apply styles.css with flexbox column layout, proper color adherence (#E3000B, #FFED00, #000000, #FFFFFF), and responsive typography (Cera Pro for headings, Arial for body). (5) Ensure app.js (if needed) initializes without errors. Verify the rendered ad matches exactly 320×480 px and the DOM is scannable by the screenshot capture system.
